sn46.47:1.1: adaliddo adaliddoti → adaḷiddo adaḷiddoti (bj); sāvatthīnidānaṁ adaḷiddo adaḷiddoti (sya-all) | ti → S1-3 daḷi- always. (pts note)
sn46.47:1.3: adaliddoti → adaḷiddoti (bj) | bahulīkatattā adaliddoti → bahulī katattā adaḷiddoti (sya-all)
sn46.47:1.6: adaliddoti → adaḷiddoti (bj, sya-all) | sattannaṁ bojjhaṅgānaṁ → sattanam bojjhaṅgānām (pts) | adaliddoti vuccatīti sattamaṁ → adaliddo ti vuccatī ti (pts)
